observations.evidence: The final status screenshot uses distinct headings for implemented/local qualification, host prerequisites, real-hardware work and future experiments. Paragraphs remain readable within the single preserved status wrapper.

Visible copy separates privateinstalled1.5/public1.4.1, exactcfad offline evidence, known OCR misses, higher warm model RSS and idle cleanup. New private ARM builds are explicitly unqualified and Pixel remains untouched.

The status uses existing brand typography and token palette, retains source-audio and experimental3D boundaries, and ends with the same overview/coverage links. It makes no competitor ranking or physical-device claim.

Can the answer be found from headings and navigation?

limitations: Visual observations are the agent’s self-assessment, not independent human approval.
Static rendering does not prove native behavior, screen-reader behavior, real email-client support, data truth or complete WCAG conformance.
Spacing, aesthetic conventions and intentional two-dimensional overflow require judgement; they are not automatic hard failures.
